# Oracle: plain go help stays byte-identical to upstream (version differs).
[!exec:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/go/1.27.3/libexec/bin/go] stop 'upstream go 1.27.3 not installed'
go help
cp stdout $WORK/our-top.txt
exec env GOROOT=/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/go/1.27.3/libexec /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/go/1.27.3/libexec/bin/go help
cp stdout $WORK/up-top.txt
cmp $WORK/our-top.txt $WORK/up-top.txt
